name: Yilong Fan

about.en: I am a Ph.D. student in Computer Science and Technology at Tianjin University.
about.zh: 我目前在天津大学攻读计算机科学与技术博士学位。

research.descriptionEn: Mixture-of-experts, sparse-depth routing, and scaling laws.
research.descriptionZh: 混合专家、稀疏深度路由与缩放定律。

research.descriptionEn: Reasoning budgets and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.
research.descriptionZh: 推理预算分配与可验证奖励强化学习。

research.descriptionEn: Semantic segmentation, medical imaging, and multimodal salient object detection.
research.descriptionZh: 语义分割、医学图像分析与多模态显著性目标检测。

educationSource: Provided by the profile owner on 2026-11-19.

aboutDetails.zh: 我主要研究大模型中的条件计算，关注如何在有限算力预算下，将计算分配给合适的专家和网络层。MaxScore 研究混合专家模型中的 token 路由，X-MoD 探索稀疏深度路由及其缩放规律。我也关注高效推理和多模态视觉理解。
aboutDetails.en: My research focuses on conditional computation in large models. I study how to allocate a limited compute budget across experts and network layers. MaxScore addresses token routing in mixture-of-experts models, while X-MoD explores sparse depth routing and its scaling laws. I also work on efficient inference and multimodal visual understanding.

aboutDetails.zh: 我也担任 ICASSP、CVPR 和 ICLR 等学术会议的审稿人。
aboutDetails.en: I also serve as a reviewer for conferences including ICASSP, CVPR, and ICLR.
